stops.note: to throw across, from trans- (across) and iacere (to throw), with irregular past participle trajectus
formed for the path of a body moving through space
stops.meaning: the path of a moving body

stops.note: settled as the English word for the curved path an object follows
stops.meaning: the curved path an object follows through space

current_meaning: the path followed by an object moving through space, or a general course of development
